strings.zh: 阿金『老伯,浅葱灯塔的电龙{NEWLINE}确实是身中剧毒,{CLEAR}非常需要你这里的药救治,{CLEAR}你快把药给我们吧！
strings.en: Gold: Old man, the Ampharos at the{NEWLINE}Olivine Lighthouse really has been badly{CLEAR}poisoned. It desperately needs your{CLEAR}medicine. Hurry, give it to us!
strings.notes: Amphy poison thread from the Lighthouse (0092 #55): medicine = Secret Potion (秘药). Old pharmacist refuses Gold/Crystal until the Champion shows a Trainer Card.; ext-review RV-014

strings.zh: 水晶『蜜柑小姐因为{NEWLINE}要照顾中毒的小明,{CLEAR}所以才拜托我们来求药。{CLEAR}我们真的没有骗您。
strings.en: Crystal: Miss Jasmine has to look{NEWLINE}after the poisoned Amphy, so she{CLEAR}asked us to come for the medicine.{CLEAR}We’re really not lying to you.

strings.zh: 我这秘药是独家特制的珍品,{NEWLINE}曾经有很多人打着救命的幌子{CLEAR}来骗我这里的药,{CLEAR}结果导致一些真正需要治病的精灵{CLEAR}无药可用不治身亡。{CLEAR}所以我就定了个规矩,{CLEAR}除非是带着重病的精灵来{CLEAR}或者是道馆馆主这样的大人物亲自来,{CLEAR}我才能把秘药交出去。{SCROLL}这个规矩蜜柑馆主是知道的,{NEWLINE}所以她绝不可能{CLEAR}派你们这种无名小辈来拿药。
strings.en: This Secret Potion of mine is a rare,{NEWLINE}specially made remedy. A lot of{CLEAR}people have come to con me out of it{CLEAR}by pretending it was life or death.{SCROLL}Because of that, some Pokémon{NEWLINE}that truly needed treatment{CLEAR}went without and died.{SCROLL}So I made a rule: unless someone{NEWLINE}brings in a seriously ill Pokémon,{CLEAR}or someone important like a Gym{CLEAR}Leader comes in person, I don’t{CLEAR}hand over the Secret Potion.{SCROLL}Gym Leader Jasmine knows that{NEWLINE}rule, so she’d never send nobodies{CLEAR}like you to fetch the medicine.

strings.zh: 水晶『我们真的没有骗您,{NEWLINE}事发突然蜜柑馆主确实不能亲至,{CLEAR}请您相信我们说的……
strings.en: Crystal: We’re really not lying to{NEWLINE}you. It all happened so suddenly{CLEAR}that Gym Leader Jasmine couldn’t{CLEAR}come herself. Please believe us...

strings.zh: 阿金『哎呀,你这个老伯真是死板,{NEWLINE}你再不把药拿出来,{CLEAR}我可就要动手抢了。
strings.en: Gold: Ugh, you’re such a stubborn{NEWLINE}old man! If you don’t bring out the{CLEAR}medicine, I’m gonna take it by force.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我也是来帮蜜柑小姐拿药的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m here to get{NEWLINE}the medicine for Jasmine too.

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像！你来的可真是时候！
strings.en: Gold: Idol! You got here just in time!

strings.zh: 水晶『太好了,{NEWLINE}有前辈在就不用担心了。
strings.en: Crystal: Thank goodness! With you{NEWLINE}here, there’s nothing to worry about.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『老爷爷你把药给我总可以吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sir, surely you{NEWLINE}can give the medicine to me?

strings.zh: 你跟这两个熊孩子是一伙的吧,{NEWLINE}我绝不会把药给你们这样的人。
strings.en: You’re in league with these two{NEWLINE}brats, aren’t you? I’ll never give{CLEAR}the medicine to people like you.

strings.zh: 阿金『老伯你看清楚了,{NEWLINE}这是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}地位可比馆主高多了！
strings.en: Gold: Take a good look, old man!{NEWLINE}This is League Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{CLEAR}Way higher up than any Gym Leader!

strings.zh: 水晶『当时蜜柑小姐{NEWLINE}拜托了我们三个一起来拿药。{CLEAR}蜜柑小姐肯定知道{CLEAR}您见到联盟冠军一定会交出秘药,{CLEAR}所以就放心让我们来了。
strings.en: Crystal: Miss Jasmine asked{NEWLINE}the three of us to come{CLEAR}for the medicine together.{SCROLL}She must have known you’d hand{NEWLINE}over the Secret Potion once{CLEAR}you saw the League Champion,{CLEAR}so she trusted us to come.

strings.zh: 你们说他是联盟冠军？{NEWLINE}确实是有点像……
strings.en: You’re saying this is the{NEWLINE}League Champion? There is{CLEAR}a bit of a resemblance...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这是我的训练家卡片,{NEWLINE}您看能证明我的身份吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Here’s my Trainer{NEWLINE}Card. Does this prove who I am?

strings.zh: 哇！你真的是冠军大人,{NEWLINE}这么说来这两个年轻人{CLEAR}说的都是真的了！{CLEAR}我这就给您取药,{CLEAR}可不能耽误了精灵的救治。
strings.en: Whoa! You really are the{NEWLINE}Champion! Then everything these{CLEAR}two youngsters said was true!{SCROLL}I’ll fetch the medicine for you{NEWLINE}right away. We mustn’t delay{CLEAR}the Pokémon’s treatment.

strings.zh: 阿金『这老伯态度转变的真快……
strings.en: Gold: Wow, the old man sure{NEWLINE}changed his tune fast...

strings.zh: 水晶『总算是可以拿到药了。
strings.en: Crystal: At last, we{NEWLINE}can get the medicine.

strings.zh: 这是能够迅速解毒的秘药,{NEWLINE}就拜托冠军大人送过去了,{CLEAR}希望能够赶得上救治小明。
strings.en: This is a Secret Potion that{NEWLINE}cures poison fast. Champion, I’m{CLEAR}counting on you to deliver it. I{CLEAR}hope it’s in time to save Amphy.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,我会尽快把药送到的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Right, I’ll get the{NEWLINE}medicine there as fast as I can.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿金、水晶,{NEWLINE}我要用飞空术尽快飞回去送药,{CLEAR}你们就留在湛蓝市等我回来吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Gold, Crystal, I’ll use{NEWLINE}Fly to get back with the medicine as{CLEAR}fast as possible. You two stay here{CLEAR}in Cianwood City until I get back.

strings.zh: 阿金『好的,有偶像亲自送药{NEWLINE}肯定没有问题。
strings.en: Gold: Got it! With my{NEWLINE}idol delivering the medicine in{CLEAR}person, it’ll be fine for sure.

strings.zh: 水晶『那就拜托前辈了,{NEWLINE}希望小明不要有事。
strings.en: Crystal: Then we’re counting{NEWLINE}on you. I hope Amphy will be OK.

strings.zh: 哎……是我太多疑了,{NEWLINE}希望小明不要因为我这个老顽固{CLEAR}而有什么危险。
strings.en: Sigh... I was too suspicious. I hope{NEWLINE}Amphy won’t come to harm because{CLEAR}of a stubborn old fool like me.

strings.zh: 阿金『有偶像亲自送药,{NEWLINE}肯定没问题的。
strings.en: Gold: With my idol delivering the medicine{NEWLINE}in person, it’ll be fine for sure.

strings.zh: 水晶『拜托前辈了,{NEWLINE}希望小明不要有事。
strings.en: Crystal: We’re counting on{NEWLINE}you. I hope Amphy will be OK.

strings.en: Welcome to the Cianwood Pharmacy.{NEWLINE}Is there anything here you need?

strings.en: You’d even try to take the{NEWLINE}medicine by force? Now I definitely{CLEAR}can’t give you the Secret Potion.

strings.zh: 每次新药材到货之后,{NEWLINE}都是由我来帮爷爷验货、分装、存放,{CLEAR}经营一家药店很不容易呢！{SCROLL}但是看到精灵们吃了我们的药之后{NEWLINE}恢复健康、重拾快乐,{CLEAR}我就觉得一切付出都是值得的。
strings.en: Every time a new batch of medicinal{NEWLINE}herbs comes in, I help Grandpa{CLEAR}inspect, portion and store it.{CLEAR}Running a pharmacy isn’t easy!{SCROLL}But when I see Pokémon get healthy and{NEWLINE}happy again after taking our medicine,{CLEAR}it makes all the work worth it.
